svg.text: The Texas 765 kV Build — All Five Dockets
PUCT Dockets 59315, 59029, 59182, 59475 and 59336 · 51 Texas counties · 2 routes approved, 3 still open · verified 9 September 2026

g.text: Corridor filed for study, not approved

svg.text: FIVE DOCKETS, 51 TEXAS COUNTIES. Two routes are approved and moving to right-of-way acquisition now. Three are still open, and in those the route has not been chosen.
Counties are those named in each PUCT case style. 51 distinct Texas counties sit in at least one 765 kV study area; 20 are on an approved route.
The agency has a team. Now you do too.
Owner-side only, nationwide, since the 1980s. We never work for the condemning agency, utility or pipeline.
No upfront cost — contingency only. Our fee is a percentage of the additional compensation we secure;
if we don’t increase your payout, you owe us nothing. Legal counsel coordinated when your case requires it.
National ROW is a right-of-way consulting firm, not a law firm. Nothing here is legal advice.
FREE REVIEW BY A SENIOR CONSULTANT
Text or email a photo of your offer letter — we read it free.

Corridor geometry read live from Oncor’s public CCN mapping service on 9 September 2026. AEP publishes no machine-readable geometry for Docket 59336, so its study area is shown by county. County boundaries from the US Census Bureau.
Approved centerlines are the built alignment to within a 200-foot corridor. Everything drawn in grey is filed for study and may never be built.
This map is an approximation for landowner orientation. It is not a survey, not an appraisal, and not legal advice.
